capabilities: Link vault folders to Plane projects and push notes as pages
Sync Plane stickies with a notes folder in both directions
Import project work items as notes with Plane properties
View work items as a Bases kanban board grouped by state
Convert Obsidian Markdown (headings, callouts, tables, checkboxes) to Plane content
disambiguation: Not a cross-device vault sync tool; it connects Obsidian to the Plane project management service.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Page sync is one-way (Obsidian to Plane), Plane's API is rate-limited to 60 requests a minute, and local images are not uploaded yet.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian and project pages, stickies, and work items in Plane live in separate tools, so content must be copied or re-entered by hand.

relations.evidence: Link a folder to a Plane project and every note in it becomes a page.

summary: Syncs Obsidian folders with Plane projects, pushing notes as pages, mirroring stickies both ways, and importing work items onto a kanban board.
